_about: Rates for prompts/runcost.py. USD per million tokens at Anthropic first-party API list prices. Runs here are billed under a subscription, so every figure computed from this file is an API-EQUIVALENT cost, not a charge. Update as_of and the rows when the pricing page changes; old run records keep the rates they were computed with.
source: Anthropic pricing page (platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing), fetched 2026-11-12. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads are 0.1x input except 0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 and 0.025x on Fable/Mythos 5.1 and 5.2. Sonnet 5.5 cache_read was 0.20 here until 2026-11-12 (quality audit round 48): records priced before then overstate Sonnet 5.5 cost.

human._about: ASSUMPTION, owner-editable: a fully loaded hourly cost for a mid-to-senior software engineer or researcher doing the same task. Used only to put the agent's own estimate of human hours into dollars. It is not a market survey.
